sn55.8:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā ñātike viharati giñjakāvasathe.
sn55.8:1.3: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn55.8:3.1: sāḷho ānanda bhikkhu kālakato āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
sn55.8:3.2: nandā ānanda bhikkhunī kālakatā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātikā tattha parinibbāyinī anāvattidhammā tasmā lokā.
sn55.8:3.3: sudatto ānanda upāsako kālakato tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karissati.
sn55.8:3.4: sujātā ānanda upāsikā kālakatā tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyanā.
sn55.8:4.1: anacchariyaṃ kho panetaṃ ānanda yaṃ manussabhūto kālaṃ kareyya
sn55.8:4.2: tasmiṃ tasmiṃ ce maṃ kālakate upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ paṭipucchissatha. vihesāvesā assa ānanda tathāgatassa.
sn55.8:4.3: tasmātihānanda dhammādāsaṃ nāma dhammapariyāyaṃ desessāmi yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya
sn55.8:4.4: khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoniyo khiṇapittivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano.
sn55.8:5.1: katamo ca so ānanda dhammādāso dhammapariyāyo yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya
sn55.8:5.2: khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoniyo khīṇapittivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano.
sn55.8:6.1: idha ānanda ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.8:6.4: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akkhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.8:6.5: ayaṃ kho so ānanda dhammādāso dhammapariyāyo
sn55.8:6.6: yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya
sn55.8:6.7: khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoniyo khīṇapittivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyanoti.
